scope: Six initial country adaptations of three deep story prototypes; ten original everyday situations per country; shared fallback for all other countries.
limits: Institutions establish possible settings, not access guarantees, uniform national culture, household language, government endorsement or future policy. No statistics copied from older sources. Dialogue, characters, motives and outcomes are original fiction. Country adaptations share prototype branch outcomes; they are not 18 independent cultural ethnographies. Native editorial review remains desirable before expanding.
